# Modes Directory Index

*Generated from the compiled canonical routing sources — do not edit manually.*

| Mode | File | Default Gear | Trigger Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Argument Audit | argument-audit.md | Gear 4 | Composes Coherence + Frame + (optionally) Propaganda passes into a full audit deliverable. |
| Balanced Critique | balanced-critique.md | Gear 4 | Produces a neutral evaluation that explicitly weighs both supporting and undermining considerations. |

| Causal DAG | causal-dag.md | Gear 4 | Builds an explicit causal directed-acyclic graph and applies do-calculus / backdoor reasoning. |
| Coherence Audit | coherence-audit.md | Gear 4 | Surfaces internal contradictions, unstated premises, and reasoning-step gaps in a single argumentative artifact. |

| Conceptual Engineering | conceptual-engineering.md | Gear 4 | Evaluates whether a concept ought to be replaced or revised on ameliorative grounds. |
| Consequences and Sequel | consequences-and-sequel.md | Gear 4 | Traces second- and third-order effects forward from a specific action. |

| Cui Bono | cui-bono.md | Gear 4 | Traces who benefits from a position, claim, or status quo. |

| Frame Comparison | frame-comparison.md | Gear 4 | Compares two or more frames a problem can be cast in, surfacing what each frame includes and excludes. |
| General Inquiry | general-inquiry.md | Gear 3 | Catch-all analytical inquiry when judgment is required but no specific analytical mode cleanly fits. |

| Mechanism Understanding | mechanism-understanding.md | Gear 4 | Explains how parts of a phenomenon produce its observed behaviour at the principle level. |

| Paradigm Suspension | paradigm-suspension.md | Gear 4 | Suspends the assumed frame to test whether unspoken paradigm commitments are doing load-bearing work. |

| Red Team (Assessment) | red-team-assessment.md | Gear 4 | Models an adversarial actor attacking the artifact and ranks vulnerabilities by severity for the user's own fix-prioritisation. Default red-team mode when ambiguous. **Parsed from `red-team` per Decision D, 2026-05-01.** |
| Relationship Mapping | relationship-mapping.md | Gear 4 | Extracts entities and typed connections from prose and renders them as a relationship graph. |

| Simple | simple.md | Gear 1 | Direct bypass response for greetings, system-meta requests, and other non-analytical prompts. |
